newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling, bearishness looms.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling, bearishness looms.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may fall further amid selling pressure, brokers said.
"The brokers are not receiving buying orders from the small investors. The retail investors lost thier confidence because of a lingering bearishness," broker Mostaque Ahmed.
He said most of the brokers were inactive after the Securities and Exchange Commission, the market watchdog, ordered an inquiry into alleged manipulation in share trading.
The DSE benchmark index closed 73.10 points or 2.82 percent down at 2,514.14 on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
